issuedBy: R1 VM lead (omp session in tmux on codex-workstation), under owner approval r1-b-model-sonnet-2026-10-17 (#88) and the owner escalation statement; not a new owner approval and not a human review
decision: Production lane B stays on anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 with concurrency 1/1, but runs with omp thinking level medium (image sha256:dd69ecb7b015c572b66453b6dc8c3e1b513b97455c7edd73842d6a2b44cb2b81, FROM e61fc252, entry.sh only) and the B-owned cross-property locator directive (commit e483592). Queue contract 0f8f88aa, PROMPTS.B, output schema, checker, projection and decoder strictness for the final JSON are unchanged; the native stream decoder admits thinking blocks only before exactly one final text block.

evidence.productionBaseline: 30 B receipts 2026-10-17 11:10Z-13:10Z: 9 supported, 6 invalid_json (leading prose), 14 whole-item abstentions all leaving /caseType (quote null) unasserted; independent source adjudication: 11 of 14 over-conservative, 2 genuine gaps, 1 ambiguous.
evidence.sonnetMedium: 20 calls: 20 bare JSON accepted; prose 0 of 6; expected supports 1 of 11; both genuine gaps held.
evidence.sonnetMediumDirective: 13 calls: expected supports 7 of 11; 1 output_json rejection (two top-level objects); genuine gaps 1 of 2 held (58559528df6d supported despite an omitted GRZ qualification; its earlier holds left /caseType unasserted, so they did not test the omission); all 9 caseType assertions bound to semantically relevant title/entity/summary quotes.
evidence.callTime: paired mean whole-call 24.3 s (medium) and 23.4 s (medium plus directive); no observed slowdown.

knownLimits: B can accept a summary that omits a material qualification (58559528df6d); A and mandatory C remain independent checks.
Stage-evidence negation guards do not cover 'ausstehenden' (district-stage-evidence.ts, protected replay file, unchanged until after release).
consequence: All lane-B jobs re-run under the new B contract; A, assessment preparation, residual preparation/extraction and Codex allowances are reused unchanged.
